bladesIdle.note: the sword stance, a blade low at either side

bladesGuard.note: the sword block with both blades

bladesA.note: left rising slash (the sword slash in a mirror), contact about 0.19 s

bladesB.note: right rising slash, contact about 0.19 s

bladesC.note: right cut down into a lunge, contact about 0.27 s

bladesD.note: turn in the air with both blades out, contact about 0.64 s

bladesHeavy.note: both blades chop down, the right about 0.39 s, the left 0.1 s later

staffIdle.note: the sword stance, the staff held low in both hands and pointing ahead

staffGuard.note: the staff raised steeply across the body in both hands

staffA.note: level sweep into a low lunge, contact about 0.32 s

staffB.note: turning backhand sweep, contact from 0.1 to 0.3 s

staffC.note: rising diagonal sweep, contact about 0.17 s

staffHeavy.note: turn in the air with the staff level: both ends pass, then the landing cut (0.3 to 0.7 s)

swordAdvance.note: level sweep driving forward into a low lunge, contact about 0.32 s

swordTurn.note: turning backhand cut, all round, contact from 0.1 to 0.3 s

swordSweep.note: wide swing from behind the shoulders, contact about 0.41 s

bladesAdvance.note: both blades sweep level, driving forward, contact about 0.32 s

bladesTurn.note: a turn with a blade out either side, all round, contact from 0.1 to 0.3 s

bladesSweep.note: both blades swing wide, the left behind the right, contact about 0.41 s

staffLeap.note: a leap and an overhead chop, contact about 0.41 s

staffSweep.note: wide swing from behind the shoulders, contact about 0.41 s
